subject: Aldera recovery evidence request — standby snapshot + keystore custody
messages:
From: Mark Turner <mark.turner@aldera.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@aldera.com, security@aldera.com
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — standby snapshot, keystore custody and warmstart measurements

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Aldera's InfoSec team has one consolidated evidence request to close our BCP/DR checklist for the platform review next week. Can you provide the following artifacts and a short point-by-point note we can attach to our SOC2 appendix?

Requested items:
- Standby snapshot manifest (CSV or JSON) showing object counts and timestamps for last three warm standby snapshots
- Keystore chain-of-custody PDF with named custodians and DocuSign attestation (or equivalent)
- Warmstart timeline/log excerpt (first 30s) showing KV-cache warm, service orchestration start, and listener-up timestamps
- Measured RTO and RPO from most recent tabletop/live failover (date and method used)
- Any known exclusions or system-level caveats (e.g., third-party dependent subsystems)

We need the artifacts by EOD Wednesday (2025-08-20) to bundle into our procurement and audit folder. If you prefer, a short call with your ops lead and our InfoSec lead to walk the artifacts is fine — we can do 30 minutes on Thursday.

Appreciate it,
Mark Turner
Head of IT Risk, Aldera Financial
mark.turner@aldera.com

--
Attachment references: None in this message
From: priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — standby snapshot, keystore custody and warmstart measurements

Mark — thanks for the clear list. I've looped in Ben (ops lead) and Laura (contracts) so we can get artifacts together and confirm any signatures needed. Quick plan from our side:

1) We will deliver a signed keystore chain-of-custody PDF and the standby snapshot manifest CSV by EOD Wednesday (2025-08-20). Keystore attestation will include named custodians and rotation records for the last 90 days.
2) Ben will extract a warmstart timeline excerpt (first 30s) from the July 21 live warmstart and include per-service timestamps (KV cache, model-loader ready, HTTP listeners).
3) We'll include a short write-up with the measured RTO/RPO from the July 21 exercise (method: scripted failover -> warmstart; tooling: internal telemetry + trace correlation).
4) If Aldera wants a live walkthrough, we can book 30 minutes Thu 08/21 10:00–10:30 PT; otherwise we'll upload artifacts to a shared Drive and provide a DocuSign link for the custody attestation.

Laura — can you confirm whether DocuSign is required or if a signed PDF (with Redacted SSNs/PII) is adequate for Aldera's audit?

Ben — assigning the warmstart log extract and the manifest generation to you; ideally include a one-paragraph summary of the observed RTO/RPO and any mitigations or caveats.

I'll prepare the Drive folder and HubSpot record (I'll paste links into the final bundle).

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

Priya / Mark — attaching the artifacts requested. See short notes below; full CSV/PDF/logs attached.

Attachments (stubs):
- standby_snapshot_manifest.csv (rows: snapshot_id, region, object_count, size_bytes, created_at)
- keystore_chain_of_custody.pdf (signed; lists custodians: Anya Rao, Diego Fernandez; rotation entries included)
- warmstart_timeline.log (excerpt: first 30s from 2025-07-21 live warmstart)

Summary:
- Most recent warmstart: 2025-07-21T02:14:03Z (test: scripted failover -> warmstart)
- Measured RTO: 00:04:12 (time from failover start to HTTP listeners reporting READY)
- Measured RPO: ~00:03:45 (largest observed KV delta; snapshot cadence 5m)
- Caveats: the warmstart exercise used a subset of background indexing workers (non-critical) offline to avoid double-write churn; third-party logging sink (LogStreamX) rehydrates asynchronously and can lag up to 45s in extreme cases.

If Aldera wants signed custodian attestations via DocuSign instead of the attached signed PDF, we can initiate that; otherwise the current PDF includes signatures and a timestamp.

Proposed next step: if you want a short walkthrough I can present the timeline and show the raw trace correlation. Available Thu 08/21 10:00–10:30 PT.

-ben
Ben Carter

Redwood Inference
